name: py-extended-types
description: Shows py-extended-types @assert_shape / @assert_field contract errors as diagnostics while you type, with quick fixes.

pyExtendedTypes.enable.description: Run py-extended-types and report its diagnostics.

pyExtendedTypes.path.markdownDescription: Command used to run py-extended-types, e.g. `["uv", "run", "--no-sync", "py-extended-types"]`. When empty, uses `.venv/bin/py-extended-types` in the workspace folder if it exists, else `py-extended-types` from `PATH`.

pyExtendedTypes.paths.markdownDescription: Paths to check, relative to the workspace folder. The whole set is re-checked on every save, since a change to one model can break a contract declared in another file.

enumDescriptions: Re-check as you type (unsaved buffers are sent to py-extended-types) and on save.
Re-check only when a Python file is saved.
pyExtendedTypes.run.markdownDescription: When to re-check. `onType` imports your unsaved code on every pause in typing, so use `onSave` for modules with side effects at import time.
